title: AfyaPlus key and at-rest encryption twin card (Azure Key Vault and AWS KMS)
status: DESIGN ONLY. No Azure subscription or AWS account was used this week; no key below exists yet. The local path is real and runs: security/resolve_secrets.py (environment injection) and security/encrypt_at_rest.py (envelope encryption with AUDIT_KEK).

regions.azure: South Africa North (nearest Azure region to Kenya; data leaves Kenya, see dpa/data_inventory.json transfers)

azure.access: RBAC role 'Key Vault Secrets User' for the API's managed identity only

aws.access: key policy allows kms:Decrypt only to the API task role

keys.local_twin: environment variables / /run/secrets files, resolved by security/resolve_secrets.py

keys.purpose: Encrypt the live data volume (docker volume triage-logs: api.jsonl, audit.jsonl, mcp_tools.jsonl, tool_metrics.db)

azure.service: Managed disk server-side encryption with a customer-managed key
azure.access: Disk Encryption Set identity: wrapKey/unwrapKey only

keys.local_twin: None: a laptop volume relies on FileVault/BitLocker. Stated as a gap, not claimed.

keys.purpose: Encrypt rotated audit and MCP logs archived to object storage

azure.service: Blob Storage, container audit-archive, encryption scope with CMK
azure.extra: immutable (WORM) policy so archived audit lines cannot be edited

aws.extra: S3 Object Lock (compliance mode) for the retention period

keys.local_twin: security/encrypt_at_rest.py: per-file AES-256-GCM data key wrapped by AUDIT_KEK; header stores kek_id and the wrapped key

envelope_flow: GenerateDataKey (AWS) / random 256-bit key (Azure): a fresh data key per file
Encrypt the file locally with AES-256-GCM under the data key
Wrap the data key with the KEK (KMS Encrypt / Key Vault wrapKey); store only the wrapped key with the file
To read: unwrap with the KEK (KMS Decrypt / Key Vault unwrapKey), then decrypt locally

who_can_use_keys.api: read JWT_SECRET and AUDIT_HASH_KEY; no key-management rights
who_can_use_keys.archive_job: wrap with the archive KEK; cannot unwrap
who_can_use_keys.dpo_and_auditor: unwrap archive data keys for a logged access or erasure request; every unwrap is in the KMS/Key Vault audit log
who_can_use_keys.nobody: export a KEK; KMS and Key Vault HSM keys are non-exportable

in_transit: TLS 1.2+ to every partner (security/transit_policy.py over config/partners.yaml). The API's own TLS terminates at the ingress (Azure Front Door / Application Gateway, or an AWS ALB with an ACM certificate); the container itself speaks HTTP only on the private network.
not_claimed: No live Key Vault or KMS call was made this week
No penetration test or HSM attestation was done
Laptop and CI runner disks are outside this design
